title: CMAR for Biotech 4 & 5 Maintenance and Repairs
short_description: Construction manager at risk services for maintenance and repairs at UMass Medicine Science Park.
project_scope: Maintenance and repair project for the Biotech 4 & 5 buildings at the UMass Medicine Science Park in Worcester. The notice indicates a total construction cost of 25.0 million and concerns existing university-related biotech facilities; no gross floor area, structural spans, or detailed technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Construction manager at risk services; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, construction/project management, cost estimating, materials testing, value engineering, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, asbestos/lead abatement, hazardous waste engineering, energy engineering, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a CMAR/construction management procurement, not a structural design tender.
- Scope is maintenance and repairs to existing biotech buildings with no indication of complex structural intervention.
- Requested disciplines focus on project management, estimating, hazardous materials, and planning rather than structural engineering.
- Building type is not one of sbp's priority categories such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or special structures.
- Moderate project size, but limited evidence of architectural or structural ambition.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The procurement is for CMAR services rather than structural engineering. Available cost basis: total construction cost 25.0 million USD.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms must be experienced in providing construction manager at risk services. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
